decision: Should ADRs ship with a Status field?
reason:
The main concern is stale metadata when an ADR is superseded. Requiring the replacing ADR to update both Supersedes and Superseded by links makes that state change reviewable in one commit.

This is still safer than inference because a broken link is detectable while an unstated lifecycle transition is invisible. Reversing the convention later would require coordinated edits across every ADR and every consumer.
tradeoff: Superseding a decision touches two ADR files and reviewers must verify that the links agree.

facets.label: Reversibility
facets.text: Changing the lifecycle convention later requires repository-wide document and tooling changes.

facets.label: Integrity
facets.text: Bidirectional links make stale status detectable during review.
